BiblicalUsage: Kelach means maturity, full strength, vigour. Job 5:26 promises thou shalt come to thy grave in a full age, like as a shock of corn cometh in in his season, and Job 30:2 asks what the strength of old men's hands could profit, in whom old age was perished.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a full age is a harvest, not a waste: God gathers the ripe corn in its season.
